product_overview: Mahalak POS is a web-based point-of-sale system for store owners to run cashier operations, manage customers and inventory, and complete sales from a tablet or desktop interface. It also includes advanced workflows such as held carts, returns, shift management, coupons, and pharmacy-specific checkout features.
core_goals: Log in as a store owner and access the POS workspace
Browse products, search inventory, and add items to a cart
Complete sales with payment and receipt generation
Manage held carts, customers, returns, and shifts from the cashier interface
Apply coupons and handle pharmacy-specific checkout workflows when available

features.name: POS Access and Workspace Login
features.description: Store owners sign in with email and password, then open the POS workspace to begin cashier operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /seller/login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> See seller session start -> Navigate to /pos/qpos -> See the POS workspace
Navigate to /seller/login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See login validation feedback

features.name: Product Browsing, Search, and Cart Building
features.description: Users browse the product grid, filter or search items, and build a cart by adding products repeatedly to increase quantity.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Browse the product grid -> Search for a product by name -> Open a product from the list -> See product details -> Add the product to the cart -> See the cart update with quantity and total
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Browse the product grid -> Filter by category -> Add a product to the cart multiple times -> See the quantity increase in the cart

features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Cashiers scan or manually enter a barcode to quickly add a matching product to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the barcode scanner -> Scan a product barcode -> See the matching product added to the cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the barcode scanner -> Enter a barcode manually -> Confirm the barcode entry -> See the matching product added to the cart

features.name: Cashier Cart Management
features.description: Cashiers adjust the cart before payment by changing quantities, removing items, or clearing the full cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add one or more products to the cart -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See the cart totals recalculate
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add products to the cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the item disappear from the cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add products to the cart -> Clear the cart -> See the cart become empty

features.name: Payment and Receipt Generation
features.description: Cashiers complete checkout using cash, card, or split payment and receive a generated receipt after the sale is saved.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Choose cash payment -> Enter the cash amount received -> Review the change calculation -> Complete the sale -> See a receipt generated
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Choose card payment -> Complete the sale -> See a receipt generated
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Choose split payment -> Enter cash and card amounts -> Complete the sale -> See a receipt generated

features.name: Coupon and Discount Application
features.description: Cashiers apply a coupon code during checkout to reduce the payable amount when a valid coupon is available.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Enter a coupon code at checkout -> Apply the coupon -> See the discounted total update
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Enter an expired or inactive coupon code -> Apply the coupon -> See coupon validation feedback

features.name: Hold Cart and Resume Later
features.description: Cashiers pause an in-progress sale, save it with a note, and later reopen it for completion or deletion.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Hold the cart -> Add a note or reason -> See the cart saved for later
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the held carts list -> Select a held cart -> Resume the cart -> See the items restored into the active cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the held carts list -> Delete a held cart -> See it removed from the saved list

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Cashiers search for an existing customer or create a new customer profile and link it to the current sale.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Search for a customer by phone number -> Select the matching customer -> See the customer linked to the sale
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open customer creation -> Enter name, phone, email, and notes -> Save the customer -> See the new customer available for selection

features.name: Sales Returns and Refunds
features.description: Cashiers locate a prior sale, select items to return, and process a refund or exchange with a required reason.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the returns workflow -> Search for a sale by sale ID -> Open the sale details -> Select items to return -> Choose refund or exchange -> Enter a return reason -> Complete the return
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the returns workflow -> Search for a sale by sale ID -> Open the sale details -> Select items to return -> Choose a refund method -> Complete the return

features.name: Shift Management
features.description: Cashiers open and close a shift with cash counts and notes, while tracking sales totals during the shift.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open shift management -> Enter starting cash amount -> Start the shift -> See the shift become active
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open shift management -> Review current shift sales totals -> Close the shift -> Enter ending cash amount -> Add close notes -> See the cash difference calculated

features.name: Pharmacy Expiry Tracking
features.description: Pharmacy stores can review expiry alerts and see product warnings when items are near expiry or blocked when expired.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open the expiry alerts view -> Review critical and warning expiry items -> See near-expiry and expired products highlighted
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add an expired product to the cart -> Proceed toward checkout -> See the sale blocked because the product is expired

features.name: Prescription Handling
features.description: Pharmacy cashiers can capture prescription details when an Rx-required product is included in the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add an Rx-required product to the cart -> Continue toward checkout -> See the prescription form open -> Enter doctor name, patient name, phone, and diagnosis -> Save the prescription -> Complete the sale
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open prescription search -> Search by patient name or phone -> View matching prescription history

features.name: Insurance Claim Processing
features.description: Pharmacy cashiers can attach an insurance company to a sale, enter coverage details, and create a claim after checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Build a cart -> Select an insurance company at checkout -> Enter policy number and coverage percentage -> Review the copay amount -> Complete the sale -> See the insurance claim created
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open insurance company management -> Add or activate an insurance company -> Return to checkout and select it for the sale

features.name: Drug Alternatives Lookup
features.description: Pharmacy users can look up alternative medicines by active ingredient and add a substitute product to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open a pharmacy product card -> Choose to view alternatives -> Review alternative drugs by active ingredient -> Add an alternative product to the cart

features.name: Pharmacy Product Editing
features.description: Pharmacy users can edit medicine-specific fields such as active ingredient, manufacturer, prescription requirement, and expiry date.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Open a pharmacy product card -> Choose to edit pharmacy details -> Update active ingredient, manufacturer, prescription requirement, or expiry date -> Save the product details -> See the updated pharmacy fields

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, React Server Components + Server Actions)

routes.description: Home page — stores, products, categories, nearby-neighborhood discovery
Auth landing (login) for customers via phone OTP
Seller registration with store details + phone OTP
Single store page with its products
Product detail page with Add to cart
Delivery — choose driver, confirm COD order
Change assigned driver for an order
Leave a review for a delivered order

features.name: Customer Registration
features.description: Register a new customer with name, unique email, strong password and Egyptian phone number
user_interactions: Fill password input (>=6 chars, must include a letter and a number)
Get redirected to phone OTP verification

features.name: Phone OTP Verification
features.description: Verify the phone number via Firebase Phone Auth using the fixed test OTP

features.name: Browse Stores and Products
features.description: Browse the home, stores, categories, and open a product detail page
user_interactions: Click into a store or category

features.name: Add to Cart
features.description: Add a product to the cart from the product page
user_interactions: Open the cart (/cart) and see the item

features.name: Checkout with Cash on Delivery
features.description: Enter delivery address, choose a driver, and confirm a COD order
user_interactions: Proceed to delivery and choose a driver

features.name: View My Orders
features.description: See the placed order in the customer account order history
user_interactions: Confirm the new order appears in the list

features.name: Seller Registration
features.description: Register a new seller/merchant with store name, description, type/category and phone, then OTP

features.name: Seller Dashboard
features.description: Seller logs in and opens the dashboard

features.name: Add Product
features.description: Seller creates a new product with name, selling price, cost price (< selling), quantity, category, optional image
user_interactions: Fill cost/purchase price lower than selling price

features.name: Seller Product List
features.description: Confirm the newly created product appears in the seller's product list
user_interactions: Confirm the new product is listed

known_limitations.issue: Authentication uses Firebase Phone OTP; email/password test-account fields do not drive login
known_limitations.impact: Automated login must use phone 01000000000 / seller 01000000001 with fixed OTP 123456 (Firebase test numbers, reCAPTCHA and SMS bypassed)

known_limitations.issue: Backend is implemented via Next.js Server Actions and Firebase SDK, not REST endpoints
known_limitations.impact: There is no /api/* surface; api_calls above reference server actions / Firebase SDK calls

known_limitations.issue: Store approval gate (is_approved) is not enforced in public getStores
known_limitations.impact: New seller stores/products may be publicly visible without an approval step
